name: What factors influence the lifespan of rental property flooring?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the lifespan of rental property flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of rental property flooring is influenced by several factors: the quality and type of material (e.g., higher-grade LVP lasts longer than basic carpet), the amount of foot traffic it receives, tenant care and maintenance habits, and proper initial installation. Subfloor quality and moisture control also play significant roles. Choosing durable materials and ensuring professional installation can significantly extend the life of your flooring investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lifespan is affected by material quality, foot traffic, tenant maintenance, and professional installation. Subfloor condition and moisture control are also key factors.
